history.photoAlt: CDISFRUTA dehydrated fruit products on a wooden table
history.photoTagline: The natural flavor of our land
history.closing: More than a snack... nature in every bite
history.paragraphOne: Founded in 2020 by a family from Ubaté, CDISFRUTA grew from the opportunities and needs that emerged during the pandemic. We make dehydrated fruit snacks and fruit infusions, promoting healthy, completely natural eating.
history.paragraphTwo: Each product comes from the agricultural richness of our region and is made with fruit grown by local farming families, ensuring quality, freshness, and authentic natural flavor.

missionVision.title: A purpose that grows with the land
missionVision.subtitle: Farming traditions, fresh ideas, and a vision for the future.

missionVision.factTitle: Dehydrated fruit: great flavor and shelf life
missionVision.factBody: We are inspired to make the most of this fruit, preserving its quality for {{months}} when stored properly.

purpose.missionDescription: We turn local fruit into natural snacks and infusions, carefully made alongside farming families to share well-being and authentic flavor.
purpose.missionAlt: CDISFRUTA products and dehydrated fruit on a wooden table
purpose.visionDescription: We aim to be a recognized Colombian brand that innovates with natural products, strengthens our farming roots, and brings Ubaté's flavor to new markets.

fresa.name: Strawberry
fresa.description: Dehydrated strawberry adds natural sweetness, a bright red color, and fruity aroma to the infusion.
fresa.benefit: A natural source of vitamin C.

pina.name: Pineapple
pina.description: Tropical dehydrated pineapple with a tart note that adds freshness and body to the infusion.

manzana.name: Apple
manzana.description: Dehydrated apple softens the blend with light sweetness and fresh notes.

cidron.name: Lemon verbena leaves
cidron.description: Citrusy aromatic leaves traditionally used in infusions for their fresh, relaxing flavor.

azucar-morena.name: Brown sugar
azucar-morena.description: Unrefined natural sweetener with gentle sweetness and caramel notes.
azucar-morena.benefit: Adds warm sweetness to the blend.

panela-menta.name: Mint-flavored panela
panela-menta.description: Artisanal panela with farm-style sweetness and a refreshing touch of mint.
